<div class="card-body">
'''Imperial Barrier''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]]<nowiki> </nowiki>([[Used Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].

<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">完全防備の壁</span>

<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">相手がキャラクターか宇宙船を配備した直後に使用する。１フォース消費すること。そのキャラクターまたは宇宙船は、このターンの間中、戦闘と移動を行うことができない。</span>

<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">無計画にデス・スターから脱出しようとした一行は、ゴミ圧縮装置の磁気反射ドアに阻まれた。</span>''



<nowiki />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' A completely fortified wall.

'''Card text:''' Use immediately after the opponent deploys a character or starship. Use 1 Force. That character or starship cannot battle or move during this turn.

'''Lore:''' The group attempting to escape the Death Star without a plan was blocked by the trash compactor's magnetic reflection door.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese refers to a magnetic reflection door; the English calls it a magnetically sealed door.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Imperial Barrier]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="video">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE&t=206s Star Wars CCG Japanese Premiere Complete Set], swccgBoosterBreaks, 3 November 2011, 3:26.</ref>
